name: elms
description: English Learning Management System - teacher's personal English teaching operating system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
